brief: The year is 26 sim days, about 24 real minutes at 1x, and the speed button tops out at 8x. Fourteen iterations of seasonal work are addressed to a viewer who would have to sit here for twenty-four minutes to see any of it. Give the viewer a way to reach another season deliberately. The hard part is this town own laws: every slow scalar is rate-capped precisely so that "it never steps" is one measurable number, and the beds, the thirteen trees, the weather fronts and the river all carry hysteresis, so an instant jump is a pop in six systems at once. Either respect the caps and make the passage of time legible while it happens, or make an explicit honest transition — but measure that nothing pops, with filmstrip cropped to the courtyard and to the far bank. This is the batch bet and it is allowed to fail; say so in the ledger if it does.
successLooksLike: A viewer thirty seconds into the page can see the courtyard in winter and come back, and the transition reads as time passing rather than as a reload.
avoid: Do not change SEASON_LEN or SEASON_START — the entire seasonal spine is anchored at 0.25 and its neutrality there is provable, which is the property that has made every seasonal brief since #12 gateable. Do not let a fast-forward leak into a permanent speed that the census, the gates or ?fast inherit.
